findings.organization: University of Tokyo Department of Pathology
findings.title: 歴代教授
findings.access: Public HTML, one GET; no login or per-person retrieval required
findings.format: 13 h5 professor sections followed by career tables; birth row explicitly states に生れ

interface.parsing: Split h5 professor headings; take the era plus four-digit-year date from the table row explicitly attached to に生れ; exact full Japanese name+pathology career links to existing academy member_key. Do not collect unmatched professor rows.

two_required_verified_examples.source_locator: 緒方 知三郎教授 / first table row explicitly ending に生れ
三田村 篤志郎教授 / first table row explicitly ending に生れ

findings.calendar_caveat: Two pre1873 rows remain old-era calendar holds; four later rows retain exact source day components without date padding. Yamagiwa raw day conflict retained.

findings.title: 日本学士院会員名簿
findings.evidence: Public bibliographic record lists Japan Academy printed membership directories since1952, with library holdings in later years. It does not display a DOB table or public full-text download.
findings.action: Park this route; no request to libraries or further scans made.

findings.title: 〔教員個人履歴カード〕（教授・助教授：追加作成分）
findings.evidence: Public catalog says578 individual cards and digital data exist, but usage condition explicitly 要審査. Metadata export is not the card-level birth data.
findings.action: Park; did not request review, access restricted data, or treat metadata as DOB records.

findings.title: 公開データベース
findings.evidence: Official page links research profiles, repository and digital archive collections; no whole-university historical professor birth-date table or downloadable birth-date dataset was verified in this bounded round.
findings.action: Stop after bounded broad search; no per-person expansion.

negative_scope: No claim that an unlocated national roster or all other public institution sources do not exist. This is the result of exactly3 bounded broad searches and body checks. Already-completed Kyoto/NDL paths were not repeated.
next_action: Integrate the six already-created academy-only UTokyo pathology claims, retaining known old-calendar/raw-source holds; stop this round of source acquisition.
